# Rookie 0.5.6

Vendored from the [crates.io release](https://crates.io/crates/rookie/0.5.6)
at [upstream commit 11d6402](https://github.com/thewh1teagle/rookie/tree/11d6402550a9f4e7bb8ab84daa0596d5644d805e/rookie-rs).
The upstream copyright and license are in [MIT-LICENSE.txt](MIT-LICENSE.txt).

Stereo removes Internet Explorer's cookie reader and its `libesedb` dependency.
Rookie 0.5.6 has no feature flag to disable that reader on Windows.
